messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Automated pager: multiple runtime pods crashlooping in gpu-pool-east. Signal: SIGSEGV in libruntime_triton.so during model warmup. Paging Maya (oncall).

Maya (oncall): On it. Which cluster and how many pods? Any recent config flips?

Omar: Affected cluster: gpu-pool-east (nodes: gpu-e-02, gpu-e-04, gpu-e-05). ~22 pods restarted in last 10m. Recent config: runtime-service v3.0.0 rolled with Triton fused kernels enabled (flag: TRITON_FUSED=1) at 02:10 UTC.

Zoe: Crash snippet from runtime container:
```
libruntime_triton.so(+0x2d9f0)
triton_fused_attention::launch(...)
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
Received SIGSEGV
```
Also `nvidia-smi` shows occasional ECC errors and GPU reset events on gpu-e-04.

Maya (oncall): Immediate plan: 1) cordon nodes gpu-e-02/04/05, 2) scale up cpu-fallback replicas, 3) apply emergency env override to disable fused kernels (TRITON_FUSED=0) as canary, 4) gather core dumps and nvcrash. Omar/Zoe take nodes and gather artifacts.

Omar: cordoned and drained gpu-e-04/05. Draining gpu-e-02 now. Initiating core collection:
```
sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 > /tmp/kubelet.log
sudo cp /var/crash/* /tmp/cores || true
gzip -c /tmp/cores/runtime.core.* > /tmp/runtime_cores.tgz
```
Uploading to s3://redwood-incidents/2167777777/

Infra-Automation: Detected a driver rollout cohort overlapping with this region at 02:05 UTC (driver 535.10 -> 535.19). Nodes gpu-e-02 and gpu-e-05 show driver mismatch. Recommendation: isolate driver upgrades or roll back if correlated.

Zoe: Observability: /v1/embeddings error rate up 500% for affected AZ. Latency doubled for requests hitting gpu-pool-east. Support-Bot flagged two customers reporting timeouts.

Maya (oncall): Which mitigation is lowest risk? Disabling runtime fused kernel via env override vs rolling back driver?

Omar: Disable env var is reversible and quick. Driver rollback is disruptive and slower. I suggest env override hotfix. I can apply canary patch to 5% pods first.

Infra-Automation: Applying env override: `kubectl -n prod set env deployment/runtime-service TRITON_FUSED=0 --record`. Canary 5% targeted to nodes in gpu-pool-east.

Maya (oncall): Approve canary. Zoe, update status page. Omar, apply core collection notes to ticket INF-3712.

Zoe: Status update posted: "Mitigation in progress: disabling a fused kernel optimization to reduce crashloops. We are rebalancing traffic; ETA 45m." :white_check_mark:

Infra-Automation: Canary applied. Monitoring metrics for canary group.

Support-Bot: Customer messages queued. One customer asks if requests were processed successfully earlier (response: some retries, no persisted data lost).

Omar: Canary looks good after 4 minutes: canary pods stable, no new SIGSEGV. Starting rollout to remaining gpu-pool-east pods.

Maya (oncall): Good. Keep driver mismatch on watch. Capture ECC/GPU resets logs for hardware team.

Zoe: Rolling env override complete. Crashloops subsided across all affected nodes. Error rate back to baseline within 9m post-rollout. Observability suggests 95th latency improved but still ~10-15% above normal due to cpu-fallback traffic.

Infra-Automation: Nodes gpu-e-04 reported GPU reset counts dropping after affected pods moved. Driver mismatch remains on gpu-e-05; scheduling it for manual rollback to 535.10 if we see further correlation.

Omar: Saved core dumps and tracebacks to INF-3712, including minimized repro harness that reproduces out-of-bounds in fused attention under variable sequence lengths. Starting branch `fix/triton-checks`.

Maya (oncall): Actions and owners: Omar = root cause + patch PR; Infra = driver upgrade gating and optional rollback plan; Zoe = customer comms + post-incident status. Postmortem owner: Maya. Please include timeline, why env toggle was chosen, and CI additions (GPU smoke tests + driver matrix).

PagerDuty: Incident severity escalated to SEV2 (partial outage impacting multiple customers).

Zoe: Customer comms: emailed top 5 affected customers, posted a detailed status update noting mitigation and next steps. One asked for an incident timeline — will include in postmortem.

Omar: Local repro shows fused kernel writes past buffer when sequence_length varies drastically (edge case). Confirmed only when TRITON_FUSED=1 and driver 535.19 or newer. Core analysis attached. Creating INF-3713 for patch work.

Maya (oncall): If stable for 30m, we'll reduce severity and hand to night oncall at 03:30 UTC. Recommended monitoring window 1h.

Infra-Automation: Suggested follow-ups: INF-3712 (artifacts), INF-3713 (fix/triton-checks patch), INF-3714 (CI GPU smoke tests + driver matrix), INF-3715 (driver upgrade policy).

PagerDuty: Incident mitigated at 2167778033. Recording follow-up tickets and recommending a follow-up postmortem.

Maya (oncall): HANDOFF -> Night Oncall @Omar: system stable, fused kernels disabled in prod, SEV2. Follow-ups assigned to you. First message ts: 2167777777

Omar: ACK. Will draft postmortem and start the patch PR in morning.

Maya (oncall): Leaving channel. :wave:
